usage: The word 岳母 (ngok6 mou5) refers to one's mother-in-law, specifically the wife of one's father-in-law.
It is used to talk about your spouse's mother, usually in a respectful or formal way.
岳母 is a noun and can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can use 岳母 to describe family relationships or when discussing family visits and interactions.
In conversations, 岳母 is often mentioned when talking about family gatherings or events involving in-laws.
